key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:087C
name: copy_four_word_slots
description: Copies four 16-bit values from one block of globals into four adjacent slots of another block, with no branches. The routine is a plain straight-line copy.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08AE
name: set_flag_and_relocate_tables
description: ORs flag bits into a byte addressed through a register, then walks two word tables and adds the table base to each stored offset to make it absolute. Table lengths come from two counter variables.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08D2
name: relocate_two_offset_tables
description: Converts every word of two offset tables into absolute addresses by adding the table base to each entry. Each table length is read from a separate counter variable.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08F8
name: dispatch_active_slot_handlers
description: Clears two status variables, then runs a helper on each non-zero entry of four 24-byte slots. For the following two slots it calls each non-zero slot's stored handler pointer instead.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0936
name: select_nearest_flagged_object
description: Scans 86-byte object records whose flag bits match and whose check succeeds, keeping the one with the smallest distance. If no record qualifies, it advances a counter and updates a scaled value in the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:09BA
name: store_record_into_indexed_slot
description: After a helper check passes, makes five helper calls and copies three 16-bit fields of a record into a global slot. The slot is chosen by a bit field of a variable, with a stride of 8 bytes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A0E
name: update_scaled_position_fields
description: Advances a counter field toward its limit, then updates two record fields by table interpolation scaled by a divisor. One result is clamped at 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A20
name: pick_closest_candidate_or_decay
description: When a status longword is negative, scans candidate records through a helper and latches the closest valid one into the record. Otherwise it decrements a counter and advances a field toward its limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A6E
name: copy_record_fields_after_checks
description: Makes two helper checks and, if both pass, runs five helper calls before copying three 16-bit record fields into globals. It returns the result of the last check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A78
name: advance_record_fields_conditionally
description: Runs helper checks on the record and either copies three fields into globals or, when the check fails, decrements a counter and advances two table-scaled fields. The copy path also reads an extra field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_record_fields_on_success
description: After one helper check passes, makes five helper calls and copies three 16-bit record fields into the global slot. It is the single-check version of the field copy routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B0A
name: compute_clamped_axis_difference
description: Subtracts one record field from a value, clamps the result to a per-record limit, and stores twice that clamped value. It then applies a divided step to a second field and runs a helper before the bounds test.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B1C
name: apply_clamped_axis_step
description: Clamps a value to a per-record limit, stores the clamped value, applies a divided step to a position field, and repeats for a second field. A helper check then decides whether the result is in range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B58
name: clamp_step_then_latch_target
description: Clamps a value, applies a scaled step to a record field, and if a helper check passes and the combined magnitude fits the limit, latches the target. Latching copies three fields into globals, sets a state byte, clears the record and returns true.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B7A
name: check_range_then_latch_target
description: Adds the absolute value of one input to another and compares the sum with a scaled limit. If it fits, the routine copies three fields into globals, sets a state byte, clears the record and returns true.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC0
name: call_record_handler_pointer
description: Calls the handler pointer stored in a fixed offset of the record that the address register points to. The jump target could not be recovered, so this is an indirect dispatch.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC6
name: resolve_hit_against_record
description: Handles a per-frame hit test for a record: it sets a timer field to 10 and checks distance against a threshold. When the record's state bits match, it calls its handler pointer and, if that passes, updates the record counters and uses the 'HIT BY ' string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D72
name: advance_record_fields_step
description: Decrements a counter field if positive, increments another field toward its limit, and recomputes a table-scaled value that is added to two record fields. One of those fields wraps back when it passes 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D8A
name: step_record_position_fields
description: Increments a counter field toward its limit, then updates two record fields by table-interpolated steps scaled by a divisor. It is the same stepping as the decrement variant without the decay.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_proximity_and_arm_target
description: Sets a state field to 10, then compares the record's position with a global within a range of 8192. If it is close, it sets the state to 3 and returns true, and a tighter range check stores a marker byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_gated_band_and_arm
description: Sets a state field to 10, then when a global gate is zero compares the distance to a global against a band of 16384 minus a scaled value. If it passes it sets the state to 13 and returns true, and a closer check marks a byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F5A
name: arm_target_within_band
description: Sets a state field to 10 and compares the distance to a global against a band of 16384 minus a scaled value. If it passes, it sets the state to 4 and returns true, and a closer check marks a byte.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0FA8
name: activate_flagged_record_once
description: Returns early if the record's active flag is already set. Otherwise it sets the flag, installs a handler pointer, copies three fields into globals with a fixed value of 128, and clears status bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:103E
name: register_record_in_slot
description: Marks a record as active by setting a flag bit and clearing its counter, then assigns it to one of two slot globals. It also updates the slot's status and calls helpers, and returns -1 when the input is zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_counter_and_reset_state
description: When a gate variable is zero, adds one plus a global to a counter and calls a helper. It then sets a state variable to 14.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:118E
name: test_record_distance_band
description: Returns zero when a record's scaled field is exceeded and its distance from a global falls outside a threshold of 16384 minus a scaled value. Otherwise it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11AC
name: test_shifted_distance_threshold
description: Compares the absolute distance between a record field and a global, shifted by 16384, against a threshold derived from a global. It returns zero when the distance is inside it, and -1 otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11D6
name: test_distance_beyond_gated_limit
description: Returns zero when a record's scaled field is exceeded and its distance from a global is greater than 8192. Otherwise it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11F4
name: test_distance_beyond_limit
description: Returns zero when the absolute distance between a record field and a global is greater than 8192, and -1 otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:120A
name: tick_slot_countdowns
description: Walks 50-byte slot records that are active and not flagged, decrementing each countdown. It reloads the countdown from a divided value when it reaches zero, and sets flag bit 2 when the countdown equals four under a global condition.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1280
name: spawn_shot_into_free_slot
description: When a timing and range test passes, it copies the shooter's position and velocity into a free slot and sets the slot's timer and flags. It increments a shot counter and references the 'FIRING ' text.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:146A
name: compute_weighted_range_value
description: For an active record, returns a product of a record field and a range factor derived from a global, scaled down. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14B6
name: run_all_record_handlers
description: Shifts a counter into a previous-value global, clears the counter, and walks every 86-byte object record. It calls the handler pointer stored in each record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14E8
name: pick_nearest_matching_record
description: When an activity counter is below its limit and a derived gap is large enough, scans records whose flag bits match. It keeps the nearest one, stores it in a global, and calls two helpers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1576
name: step_motion_with_countdown_retarget
description: Steps a record's rate field toward its target, then integrates position and angle from table-based sine-style values. When a countdown reaches zero it reinstalls the handler and picks the nearest flagged record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15DE
name: integrate_motion_near_or_far
description: Adds a distance-based step to position and angle fields, using a sine-style lookup table, and wraps the angle when it passes 16384. When within a short range it zeroes the motion fields and sets a flag.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1678
name: decay_speed_and_integrate_motion
description: Decrements a speed field toward zero, or sets status bits and a handler pointer when it is already zero. It then integrates position and angle from table-based values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:169A
name: integrate_motion_after_flag_reset
description: Clears status bits and sets them again with a handler pointer when a counter reaches its limit. It then integrates position and angle from table-based values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16B6
name: arm_flags_and_integrate_motion
description: Sets status bits and two handler pointers, then integrates position and angle from table-based values, the same way as the other motion updates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16D0
name: step_speed_then_integrate
description: Adjusts a rate field by threshold, zeroes a second rate, and steps a speed field toward its target. When the target is reached it clears a flag and restores a saved handler pointer, then integrates motion.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16DE
name: boost_rate_and_integrate_motion
description: Sets a rate field to 512-style boost when an input is below 300, zeroes a second rate, and steps a speed field toward its target. When the target is reached it clears a flag and restores the saved handler, then integrates motion.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1708
name: restore_handler_and_integrate
description: Clears a status flag, restores a saved handler pointer, and integrates position and angle from table-based values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1718
name: update_record_targeting_state
description: Runs a per-frame check for a record: advances its counter toward a limit and tests candidate records against a distance threshold of 1536. On a match it stores the candidate's data, otherwise it resets the handler and status bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1904
name: apply_control_input_to_motion
description: Converts a 16-bit control value from the input record into a scaled step, clamps it against a limit, and applies it to the rate field before integrating motion. An input of 512 selects a special default path.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1940
name: apply_scaled_input_to_motion
description: Scales a control value from the input record, clamps it against a limit, and applies it to the rate field before integrating motion. It has no special-case value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1960
name: guarded_periodic_range_check
description: When a status bit is clear and a frame counter masks to zero, checks the record's distance. Beyond 22400 it resets the handler and clears status bits, otherwise it scans eight slot records against a threshold.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:197C
name: periodic_slot_range_scan
description: On a periodic frame counter tick, checks the record's distance and, if it is inside range, scans eight slot records against a threshold. It latches the matching slot's data into the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A14
name: scan_slots_for_gap
description: Loops over slot records while a distance test holds, stopping when a slot falls inside its window. It then increments a rate field and runs the usual integrated update.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_record_handler_state
description: Installs a handler pointer, clears the record's status bits, and zeroes a timer field. It does nothing else.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_scaled_field_delta
description: Returns the difference between an input value and a record field, shifted right by 5 bits. It also calls three helpers before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once. The routine is a bare return with no reads or writes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A7A
name: clamp_rate_then_integrate
description: Clamps a rate toward the distance of an input value, applies the step, and integrates position and angle from table-based sine-style values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A88
name: integrate_motion_toward_input
description: Computes the distance from an input value to a record field, applies a clamped step to the rate, and integrates position and angle from table-based values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A98
name: integrate_motion_with_limit
description: Clamps an input value to a negated limit, applies the step to the rate, and integrates position and angle with angle wrapping at 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AB0
name: integrate_limited_motion_step
description: Clamps an input value to a limit, applies a rate step, and integrates position and angle from table-based values with the same wrap.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AF0
name: update_moving_record_with_tests
description: Large per-frame update for a moving record: it integrates position and angle from table-based values, runs range and collision tests against other records, and calls several helpers. It references the 'fired by' text.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1E7E
name: save_record_to_slot_table
description: Copies three fields of a record into globals and, when the active slot matches the record, stores them into a slot table indexed by a bit field. It then sets a marker value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialize_record_from_template
description: Initialises a record from a template: copies position from the template with an offset from a global, sets the state and speed fields to one of two value sets, and installs its handler. It also resets the timer and calls helpers when in range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1FFA
name: update_frame_timing_scale
description: Clamps a scale factor between 4 and 15, halves it when a flag is set, and derives two values from it. It then decrements counters and runs helpers at fixed frame intervals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_two_timers
description: Decrements two counter globals if each is non-zero, then returns a byte. The routine has a single instruction of work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_two_countdowns
description: Decrements two counter globals when each is non-zero. Its only work is those two conditional decrements.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20F6
name: update_gunfire_projectiles
description: Advances up to four active projectile records each frame by counting down their lifetime and adding velocity to position. It then tests each one against a distance threshold to detect gunfire hits, and references the 'destroyed by gunfire' and 'Hit by gunfire' text.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:22C2
name: integrate_eight_slot_motion
description: Loops over eight 8-byte slot records, adding 10 to a velocity field and moving each position by that velocity scaled down. It also adds 1536 to a third field per slot, and returns a slot index when a flag is negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:234C
name: damp_and_accumulate_rate
description: When a value is positive, steps a second value down toward minus 16 by 12 per call and adds it into the first value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2372
name: store_event_entry
description: Sets a status global to 255, writes an input value and a counter into two words of an event table, then calls a helper.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_and_scale_axis_values
description: Derives two global values by shifting, clamps each to a lower bound and an upper bound, and resets the paired value at each limit. It then updates the dependent values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2466
name: snapshot_state_and_raise_floor
description: Copies four state globals into a saved set, then raises the tenth field of each active record to at least a computed minimum.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_closest_active_record
description: Scans records whose flag bits match a mask and are not in a masked state, measuring distance to a global. It keeps the closest record found.
